verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live, versioned production REST API platform that returns a structured error contract, so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, nothing in the pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec. The developer hub was not fetched beyond robots.txt, and no evidence shows spec files being published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
